bifrost: springboard/render/src/gfx.rs (CPU blur), springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs (GPU dual-Kawase blur pyramid), springboard/render/src/gfx/rotate.rs (bilinear resample), springboard/render/src/emoji.rs (area and bilinear resample), springboard/src/gpu/egl.rs (EGL/GLES compute and render path)
summary: BifrOSt has a GPU blur pyramid and bilinear resampling, both used internally by the shell for glass and scaling. It exposes no app-facing GPU image-filter, histogram, matrix or neural-network API, and no Metal-style kernel layer; most of the framework has no counterpart.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/egl.rs (EGL/GLES device init on Mesa via GBM)
features.note: Metal-only device query. BifrOSt uses EGL/GLES on Linux, so the Apple call has no direct counterpart.

features.feature: Gaussian and box blur image filters
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/gfx.rs:476 (three-pass CPU box blur); springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs:300 (GPU dual-Kawase blur pyramid)
features.note: Blur exists only as shell-internal rendering for glass and shadows. There is no app API, no sigma-based gaussian, and no tent filter.

features.feature: Morphological filters (erode, dilate, area min and max)
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No morphology code in springboard/render or springboard/ui.

features.feature: Convolution, median, Sobel and Laplacian filters
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-metal-performance-shaders, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. springboard/apps/daw/src/conv.rs is an audio convolver and is not an image counterpart.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs:300 (blur pyramid for the live backdrop)
features.note: A fixed dual-Kawase down and up pyramid for glass only. No Laplacian pyramid and no app API.

features.apple: MPSImageThresholdBinary, ThresholdToZero, ThresholdTruncate and their inverses
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No image thresholding in the repo.

Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The index and a grep for histogram found nothing in the render or shell code.

features.feature: Integral images and statistics (mean, variance, min and max)
features.note: Wave 3 (theme-02, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No image statistics API.

features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/gfx/rotate.rs:341 (bilinear taps); springboard/render/src/emoji.rs:401 (area-average down, bilinear up); springboard/render/src/gfx.rs:359 (bilinear asset resize)
features.note: Bilinear and area-average only. No Lanczos. Not exposed through an SDK image API.

features.apple: MPSImageAdd, MPSImageSubtract, MPSImageMultiply, MPSImageDivide, MPSImageConversion, MPSImageTranspose
features.note: Wave 3 (theme-02, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Compositing is done on the CPU in gfx.rs. No GPU arithmetic kernels or colour-space conversion API.

features.feature: Reduction filters (row and column min, max, sum, mean)
features.apple: MPSImageReduceRowMax and the other MPSImageReduce* classes
features.note: Wave 3 (theme-02, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No reduction code.

features.feature: Euclidean distance transform, guided filter, keypoints
features.note: Wave 4 (w4-metal-performance-shaders, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No vision primitives in the repo.

features.feature: Neural network graphs and CNN layers

features.note: Wave 5 (theme-12, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. A search for inference, onnx and tensor across springboard returned nothing. No ML runtime exists.
Wave 5 (theme-12, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No recurrent layers.

features.feature: Matrix and vector kernels (multiply, decomposition, solve, softmax)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 15 tests. Wave 4 (w4-metal-performance-shaders, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No GPU linear algebra in springboard.
Ray intersection is not a desktop-shell need, and the framework's acceleration structure classes are deprecated in the Apple docs.

features.feature: Kernel base classes and keyed archiving
features.apple: MPSKernel, MPSUnaryImageKernel, MPSBinaryImageKernel, NSKeyedArchiver with MPSKeyedUnarchiver
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/coding.rs (Codable and plist) for serialisation; no kernel base class
features.note: There is no kernel abstraction for apps to subclass. Serialisation exists, but for app data, not GPU kernels.

gaps: No app-facing GPU compute or image-filter API. The GPU path (springboard/src/gpu/) serves the shell only.
No histogram, threshold, morphology, convolution or statistics filters for images.
No neural network or recurrent layers, and no ML inference runtime anywhere in springboard.
No GPU matrix or linear algebra kernels.
Resampling is bilinear or area-average only. Lanczos is missing.
Blur is shell-internal, with no gaussian sigma parameter and no SDK entry point.
